Vaginal Rejuvenation Gallery Contact Virtual Consultation 978.846.6807 Home » About » Areas We Serve Areas We Serve Home » About » Areas We Serve Adorn Medical Aesthetics is a premier boutique med spa located in North Andover, just 30 minutes north of Boston and 15 minutes from southern New Hampshire. Proudly serving the Merrimack Valley, the North Shore, and surrounding communities, Adorn specializes in natural-looking aesthetic treatments tailored to each client’s goals. We offer advanced injectables, laser therapies, and skin rejuvenation services in a luxurious, unrushed setting. About Adorn Medical Aesthetics Adorn Medical Aesthetics is a boutique medical spa in North Andover, MA, offering a refined approach to aesthetic care. Led by nurse injector Jessica Bragel, Adorn blends medical expertise with an artistic eye to deliver natural results. With advanced training in injectables, laser therapy, skin rejuvenation, and wellness services, our team is committed to elevating each client’s innate beauty without overcorrection. Every treatment is thoughtfully customized to support long-term skin health and age-defying enhancements. Communities served Adorn Medical Aesthetics proudly serves clients across the Merrimack Valley, North Shore, and Southern New Hampshire regions. Conveniently located in North Andover, we welcome patients from Andover, Tewksbury, Haverhill, Methuen, Middleton, and surrounding towns. Adorn is a trusted destination for expert aesthetic care in a centrally accessible location. Our services Neuromodulators We use neuromodulators like Botox®, Dysport®, Jeuveau®, and Xeomin® to soften dynamic wrinkles caused by facial expressions. These FDA-approved injectables target the underlying muscles responsible for frown lines, crow’s feet, forehead creases, and more. The result is a smoother, more relaxed appearance that still looks completely natural. Dermal fillers Dermal fillers restore volume, enhance contours, and smooth out wrinkles. We offer a wide selection of premium fillers, including Juvederm®, Restylane®, Radiesse®, Revanesse®, and RHA®, to treat areas like the cheeks, lips, jawline, temples, and under-eyes. Each treatment is customized to subtly enhance your features while maintaining facial harmony and balance. PRP/PRF Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) and platelet-rich fibrin (PRF) therapies use your body’s own growth factors to stimulate skin rejuvenation and hair restoration. These natural treatments are ideal for reducing dark under-eye circles, improving skin tone and texture, and restoring thinning hair. PRP/PRF can also be combined with microneedling to enhance healing and results. Morpheus8 RF microneedling Morpheus8 combines microneedling with radiofrequency energy to remodel collagen, tighten skin, and improve texture at a deeper level. This device is effective for treating fine lines, acne scars, sagging skin, enlarged pores, and uneven tone on the face, neck, and body. The controlled energy delivery penetrates below the surface to stimulate skin renewal. DiamondGlow facial The DiamondGlow facial is a multi-tasking treatment that exfoliates, extracts, and infuses medical-grade serums in one seamless session. Using a diamond-tipped wand, this treatment gently resurfaces the skin while simultaneously delivering customized serums tailored to your skin concerns. It leaves the skin visibly brighter, smoother, and more hydrated. Laser treatments We offer a range of laser therapies, including BBL® (BroadBand Light), Moxi®, and IPL photofacials, to address sun damage, age spots, redness, acne, and overall skin tone. These treatments work by stimulating collagen and targeting pigmentation without damaging the skin’s surface. Our laser treatments deliver clearer, firmer, more radiant skin over time. Sculptra Sculptra is an advanced injectable treatment that revitalizes your skin by stimulating the production of natural collagen. Available at Adorn Medical Aesthetics in North Andover, it restores facial volume, smooths wrinkles, and improves skin texture. Ideal for those seeking gradual, long-lasting rejuvenation, Sculptra enhances facial contours and delivers a youthful, natural-looking appearance without surgery or extended downtime. IV Hydration Therapy and Vitamin Injections IV Hydration Therapy and Vitamin Injections deliver vital vitamins, minerals, and nutrients directly into the bloodstream for optimal absorption. These treatments help strengthen the immune system, enhance metabolism, improve energy, and relieve fatigue, dehydration, or hangovers. They also promote mental clarity, faster recovery, and overall wellness, supporting your body’s natural balance and vitality.
